description: OpenELIS multi-analyte laboratory vocabulary over OHS FHIR Data Pipes projections.

freshness.updateBehavior: An operator-triggered FULL FHIR_SEARCH run recreates the sink projections; only succeeded runs with a source watermark are current.

views.name: analytics.lab_result_fact_v1
views.grain: Exactly one row per FHIR Observation, with at most one Specimen matched by resource key.

columns.name: observation_id
columns.description: FHIR Observation resource identifier and stable row identity for the laboratory result.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: FHIR Patient resource identifier referenced by the observation.

columns.name: service_request_id
columns.description: FHIR ServiceRequest resource identifier referenced by the observation.

columns.name: specimen_id
columns.description: FHIR Specimen resource identifier referenced by the observation.

columns.name: result_status
columns.description: FHIR Observation status for the laboratory result.

columns.name: observed_at
columns.description: FHIR Observation effective date and time used to place the result clinically.

columns.name: test_code_system
columns.description: Coding-system URI associated with the observation test code.

columns.name: test_code
columns.description: OpenELIS/FHIR test code for the observation.

columns.name: test_name
columns.description: OpenELIS test display name. A question naming an analyte must constrain this field rather than assume the view contains only that analyte.

columns.name: result_value
columns.description: Numeric FHIR Quantity value; do not aggregate across unlike units.

columns.name: result_unit_system
columns.description: Coding-system URI associated with the FHIR Quantity unit.

columns.name: specimen_received_at
columns.description: FHIR Specimen received date and time when a matching specimen is available.

columns.name: receipt_to_release_minutes
columns.description: Elapsed minutes from Specimen.receivedTime to Observation.issued.

terminology: The current OpenELIS load contains Viral Load, CD4 absolute count, CD4 percent (%), Hemoglobin, Platelets, White Blood Cells Count (WBC), Creatinine, GPT/ALAT, and Glucose.
The current OpenELIS load resolves Viral Load by stable GUID b50d156e-0f6f-40cd-921c-4e831602a623 and uses copies/ml.
When a question names a test, constrain test_name with a named parameter; never rely on the dataset containing only one test type.

freshness.updateBehavior: Operator-triggered FULL FHIR_SEARCH after explicit HAPI backfill; query provenance carries run ID, source watermark, completion state, and observed lag.

examples.question: Show viral load results since 2026-01-01 with value, unit, release date, and receipt-to-release time.
examples.sql: SELECT patient_id, result_value, result_unit, issued_at, receipt_to_release_minutes FROM analytics.lab_result_fact_v1 WHERE test_name = :test_name AND observed_at >= :start_at ORDER BY observed_at
